name: dark academia
tagline: has never finished the secret history but owns three copies
description: A romanticized fantasy of old libraries, Greek tragedy and candlelit essay crises. Tweed, turtlenecks and oxford shoes meet classical music and annotated paperbacks. It's studying as a lifestyle, preferably in the rain, preferably in a library that smells like 1890.
